description:
With WLED, you can easily and efficiently manage and control all your WLED light devices from your Android device. Our app automatically detects and updates the device list, and offers customizable names, a hide or delete feature, and a light and dark mode. Plus, our app supports both phones and tablets.
Try it now and see how it can improve your WLED light control experience.
Main Features:
• Now available on tablets too!
• Automatic device detection (mDNS)
• All lights are accessible from one list
• Custom names
• Opens control UI immediately if connected to WLED in Access Point mode
• Hide or delete devices
• Light and dark mode
